1. Introduction

This document sets out the operating plan for the next financial

year. It covers staffing, budget and the main risks we expect to

face, together with the actions we will take to manage them.

1.1 Scope

The plan applies to all programs run from the San Francisco and

London offices. It does not cover affiliated projects that have their

own governance arrangements.

2. Priorities

Grow the number of placements into high-impact roles.

Expand employer partnerships in government.

Track outcomes for at least two years after each

program.

Strengthen operations so that the team can run more

programs without burning out.

Area Budget Owner

Programs $4.2M Delivery team

Operations $1.1M Head of Operations
